Markers for the with_refs method of VJP functions

Source: R/ad_accum.R
ad_GradValue.Rd

Ports of jax.ad.GradValue, jax.ad.DontWant, jax.ad.GradRef and jax.ad.DidntWant. The arguments of vjp_fun$with_refs(...) (see vjp()) have the structure of the primal arguments; each leaf is a new_ref() (the gradient is added to it in place), ad_GradValue() (the gradient is returned, the default) or ad_DontWant() (the gradient is not computed). The VJP function then returns ad_GradRef() for the leaves accumulated into a ref and ad_DidntWant() for the leaves not wanted.

Usage

ad_GradValue()

ad_DontWant()

ad_GradRef()

ad_DidntWant()

Value

A marker object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
r <- vjp(function(x, y) x * y, 3, 4)
ref <- new_ref(as_jax(0, "float32"))
r[[2]]$with_refs(ad_DontWant(), ref)(1)
ref[]  # 3
} # }
